name: Zombie Waves
hook: Hold the base against bigger and bigger waves.
how: Zombies come from every side, more each wave, and go for the generator when nobody is in their way. Shoot them down, stand next to a friend who goes down to get them back up, and keep the generator running.
controls: WASD and mouse, or two thumb sticks
uses: The highest wave each player reached.
The host's browser moves every zombie and runs the waves; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
AI teammates fill the squad until enough people join.
Every survivor, zombie and shot shows up for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a boss zombie every fifth wave
Let players build barricades between waves
Make it aliens on a moon base
